basic_profile.bio: A literary enthusiast who has recently ventured into the world of Reddit. Based in Portland, Oregon, I spend my days working as a freelance copywriter. When I'm not crafting words for clients, I dive into the realms of poetry and classic novels. I have a particular fondness for Charles Bukowski's works, especially his poetry. In my free time, you'll find me exploring the local indie music scene or playing online games like Bedwars. I'm currently single, and my typical online hours are late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in literature comes from a combination of a degree in English Literature and a lifelong passion for reading. I have a keen interest in 20th-century poets and novelists, often exploring their works during my leisure time. Additionally, my background in copywriting has honed my skills in crafting engaging content and narratives.
